name: ttd

relevance.justification: Core BioThings entity types: drugs (InChIKey/PubChem CID → MyChem), therapeutic targets (UniProt → MyGene), diseases (ICD-11 → MyDisease). The database provides drug-target, drug-disease, and target-disease associations — exactly the kind of multi-entity relationship data BioThings pending.api is designed to serve. A BioThings TTD plugin is already deployed at https://biothings.transltr.io/ttd, confirming relevance.

novelty.justification: Existing BioThings TTD plugin (v8.1.01, June 2023, 876,046 records) already covers core drug-target data. TTD 2026 (v10.1.01 in bulk files) brings: (1) expanded counts — 40,398 drugs (+6K from 2022), 3,798 targets (+700 from 2022); (2) ICD-11 disease annotations in drug-disease and target-disease files (novel standard vs. the 2023 plugin); (3) three entirely new data types described in the 2026 paper — target perturbation profiles (CMap/LINCS, 10,506 profiles), FDA label clinical data (44,649 labels), and cytotoxic/antimicrobial activity landscapes — but these are NOT yet present in the bulk download files. Score 3: version update with meaningful expansion + novel data types pending bulk access.

openness.justification: All 6 download files freely accessible at https://ttd.idrblab.cn/files/download/ with no authentication required. License: CC BY-NC 4.0 (confirmed from NAR publication and consistent across all TTD versions). NC restriction does not block BioThings ingestion — BioThings has already deployed TTD under this license. No paywall or click-through gate.

evidence.scope: 3,798 therapeutic targets (protein/gene, with UniProt, function, target type: Successful/Clinical/Preclinical/Literature) and 40,398 drugs (InChIKey, SMILES, InChI, trade name, clinical status, therapeutic class) with drug-target, drug-disease (ICD-11), and target-disease (ICD-11) associations. Also includes biomarker-disease data and cross-reference identifiers (PubChem CID, ChEBI, CAS, ATC).
evidence.overlap: Core drug-target data already in BioThings TTD v8.1.01. Drug identifiers (InChIKey, PubChem CID, ChEBI) overlap with MyChem.info sources. The drug-target association layer is the primary novel contribution for pending.api. ICD-11 disease codes are a new identifier standard not present in the 2023 plugin.

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0
restrictions: Non-commercial use only; commercial reuse requires OUP permission

risks: Existing BioThings TTD plugin (v8.1.01) already deployed — this is a version update, not a new datasource
CC BY-NC license limits commercial use
Download files still on v10.1.01 (2024); the 2026-specific new data types (perturbation profiles, FDA labels, cytotoxicity) are not yet in bulk download
TTD uses a non-standard key-value row format (not CSV) — parser must aggregate rows by entity ID
New domain (ttd.idrblab.cn) differs from old plugin's db.idrblab.net — URLs need updating
next_actions: Proceed to plugin generation — update the existing BioThings TTD plugin to v10.1.01 with new download URLs
Use ttd.idrblab.cn as the canonical download domain (confirmed working with direct file access)
Monitor for future bulk download files covering perturbation profiles and FDA labels
